Identification.LongTitle: An Act to implement certain provisions of the budget tabled in Parliament on November 4, 2025
Identification.BillSponsor: MINISTER OF FINANCE AND NATIONAL REVENUE

Provision.Text: Her Excellency the Governor General recommends to the House of Commons the appropriation of public revenue under the circumstances, in the manner and for the purposes set out in a measure entitled “An Act to implement certain provisions of the budget tabled in Parliament on November 4, 2025”.
Part 1 implements certain measures in respect of the Income Tax Act and the Income Tax Regulations by

Provision.Label: (a)
Provision.Text: expanding the rollover for small business corporation shares;

Provision.Label: (b)
Provision.Text: expanding the list of expenses recognized under the Disability Supports Deduction;

Provision.Label: (c)
Provision.Text: exempting the Canada Disability Benefit from income;

Provision.Label: (d)
Provision.Text: aligning the taxation of investment income and active business income earned and distributed by controlled foreign affiliates with the rules that currently apply to Canadian-controlled private corporations;

Provision.Label: (e)
Provision.Text: extending the deadline for making certain charitable donations eligible for tax support in the 2024 tax year;

Provision.Label: (f)
Provision.Text: increasing the limit under the Lifetime Capital Gains Exemption so that it applies on up to $1.25 million of eligible capital gains, applicable to dispositions that occur on or after June 25, 2024, with indexation of the limit to resume in 2026;

Provision.Label: (g)
Provision.Text: exempting the first $10 million in capital gains on the sale of a business to a worker cooperative and amending the corresponding exemption for sales to an employee ownership trust;

Provision.Label: (h)
Provision.Text: removing the tax-indifferent investor exception to the synthetic equity arrangement anti-avoidance rule;

Provision.Label: (i)
Provision.Text: improving the efficiency of the Home Accessibility Tax Credit;

Provision.Label: (j)
Provision.Text: implementing the Personal Support Workers Tax Credit;

Provision.Label: (k)
Provision.Text: enhancing the SR&ED program by increasing the annual expenditure limit and taxable capital phase-out thresholds for the enhanced 35% SR&ED credit, extending the enhanced credit to eligible Canadian public corporations and restoring the eligibility of SR&ED capital expenditures;

Provision.Label: (l)
Provision.Text: extending the Mineral Exploration Tax Credit for individuals who invest in eligible mining flow-through shares for two years to March 31, 2027 at the current rate of 15%;

Provision.Label: (m)
Provision.Text: expanding the eligibility of the Critical Mineral Exploration Tax Credit to bismuth, cesium, chromium, fluorspar, germanium, indium, manganese, molybdenum, niobium, tantalum, tin and tungsten;

Provision.Label: (n)
Provision.Text: amending the Canada Carbon Rebate for Small Businesses;

Provision.Label: (o)
Provision.Text: extending the full credit rates for the Carbon Capture, Utilization and Storage investment tax credit to 2035;

Provision.Label: (p)
Provision.Text: expanding the eligibility for the clean technology investment tax credit to support the generation of electricity and heat from waste biomass;

Provision.Label: (q)
Provision.Text: expanding the eligibility for the clean technology manufacturing investment tax credit to investments in eligible polymetallic projects and to additional qualifying materials;

Provision.Label: (r)
Provision.Text: providing a refundable investment tax credit to qualifying corporations and trusts for investments in certain clean electricity property;

Provision.Label: (s)
Provision.Text: amending the alternative minimum tax to exempt certain trusts for the benefit of Indigenous groups;

Provision.Label: (t)
Provision.Text: precluding a corporation from qualifying as a mutual fund corporation where it is controlled by or for the benefit of a corporate group;

Provision.Label: (u)
Provision.Text: extending the period during which agricultural cooperatives can distribute tax-deferred patronage dividends paid in shares to their members until the end of 2030;

Provision.Label: (v)
Provision.Text: narrowing the rules related to reporting by trusts;

Provision.Label: (w)
Provision.Text: providing the Minister of National Revenue with the authority to waive the withholding requirement for payments to certain non-resident service providers;

Provision.Label: (x)
Provision.Text: allowing the sharing of information for the purposes of administering and enforcing the Canada Labour Code as it relates to the misclassification of employees;

Provision.Label: (y)
Provision.Text: reforming Canada’s transfer pricing rules;

Provision.Label: (z)
Provision.Text: reinstating the accelerated investment incentive and immediate expensing for certain qualifying assets;

Provision.Label: (z.1)
Provision.Text: providing an accelerated capital cost allowance of 10% for new eligible purpose-built rental projects;

Provision.Label: (z.2)
Provision.Text: providing immediate expensing for new additions of property in respect of productivity-enhancing assets;

Provision.Label: (z.3)
Provision.Text: introducing a temporary non-refundable tax credit applicable where an individual’s non-refundable tax credit amounts exceed the first income tax bracket threshold; and

Provision.Label: (z.4)
Provision.Text: implementing a number of technical amendments to correct inconsistencies and to better align the law with its intended policy objectives.
